same_host_timing.scope: Same-reaction Mac cohort: both AAM directions completed on Mac at seed settings 1 and 2; SLAP mapping complete. AAM search CPU includes finalizing/compressing its saved output. SLAP workflow CPU includes graph construction, mapping and export but excludes IO. Reference-membership verification excluded for both. SLAP uses both directions, binary/weighted modes, uncut and all single-edge cuts. Not a comparison of identical output products; higher-seed mixed-host timings excluded.
